scope.description: Whole octave application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Matrix/numerical programming, linear algebra, signal processing, optimisation, statistics, plotting and packages.

coverage.rationale: Several useful 1D numerical operations exist, but matrix programming, plotting and most numerical families/packages are absent.

scope.description: Real-valued 1D tables, signal transforms, fitted trends, integration/derivatives and resampling.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Declared analyses and labelled tables hide Octave code, while users still compose algorithm choices and sampling constraints.

limitations: Real-valued bounded 1D scope only; no complex values, missing data, plotting or authored functions; FFT has uniform power-of-two sampling limits.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
